title: Automatic calibration does not work in watch forced mode
symptom: Automatic calibration does not work when the collector runs in watch forced mode. The user uses a Contour Next Cone bg-meter connected to xDrip, and automatic calibration works when the collector runs on the phone, but not in forced mode. No automatic calibrations have occurred in a week of forced mode.
evidence_quote: Automatic calibration does not seem to work when you run the collector in watch forced mode.
